# Fonts for edited text

When you edit text, the PDF's own fonts are used. These free fonts are used
instead for letters a PDF's font doesn't contain (PDFs usually include only
the letters they use):

| File | Looks and measures like | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Liberation Sans | Arial, Helvetica | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Liberation Serif | Times New Roman | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Liberation Mono | Courier New | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Carlito | Calibri | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Caladea | Cambria | Apache License 2.0 |
| Noto Sans SC | Chinese (Simplified, also covers common Traditional characters). The regular weight of the variable font, saved as a static TrueType font | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The licence texts are in the `LICENSE-*.txt` files.
